decisions.reason: Garage door operators have a dedicated page and complete the firm's one-source garage system offering, so the visible commitment and strategic centrality make retention very likely.
The solid wood sectional door is only mentioned and is a niche item, but the firm has invested in it and it is just one year old, so any weak demand can still be read as temporary.
The remote-controlled operator fits naturally with the operator line and the trend toward convenient, customer-near solutions, so dropping it after one year would contradict the announced direction.
The glazed industrial sectional door uses the firm's integrated manufacturing and serves core commercial customers, and one year of results is too early to abandon the investment.
The insulated glazed variant supports the firm's thermal-solution positioning and regulatory-compliance claims, which justifies continued commitment.
A dedicated web page signals strong public commitment to this industrial door, making withdrawal within a year unlikely.
